blocking_findings.description: The new hypothesis-intent and intent-endpoint correspondence guards apply to legacy and v2 relations, but their semantic negative controls exercise only v2. The legacy tests mutate endpoint kinds or media scope, so they cannot detect acceptance of an existing, correctly typed endpoint belonging to a different intent. The sealed Plan explicitly requires separate legacy/v2 witnesses. In an isolated execution using the actual preparation and reader functions, disabling rejection for the legacy hypothesis correspondence made the mismatched relation usable with no diagnostics, while the existing legacy scope, endpoint-kind and partial-support controls still passed on direct and SQLite-reader paths. This is a coverage failure, not a claim that the unmodified guard currently accepts the mismatch.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Add isolated legacy same-kind hypothesis-intent and intent-endpoint mismatch controls with valid references, exact literal diagnostics and valid counterparts. Exercise both adapters and demonstrate that bypassing each legacy correspondence rejection fails its ordinary control while preserving reference consumption.
